findings.problem: Match screen lost Bradley has negative delta but visually shows1585→1615; winner Mirelle has positive delta but visually shows1706→1677. RTL context reorders numeric before/after operands around a rightward arrow. Signed deltas also render sign on the right.
findings.source_context: platform/apps/web/src/pages/Match.tsx175–176 outputs r.before + translated arrow + r.after in inheritedRTL td.num, without atomic LTR isolation.
findings.proposal: Keep numeric transition as atomic LTR data, e.g. bdi dir=ltr around before→after, and isolate signed numeric deltas/ordered win-loss data consistently. Do not change catalog arrow or manually reverse Unicode text.

findings.key: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Other players see it.
findings.problem: Correctly stored literal (0–9) is visually displayed as(9–0) in Urdu registration hint. The allowed ASCII-digit constraint remains understandable but numeric range ordering is wrong.
findings.proposal: Isolate the Latin/numeric range with an LTR boundary in rendered presentation, or have a distinct editor revise the specific Urdu hint to natural prose 0 سے9 with independent reviewer recheck. No catalog edits made by reviewer.
findings.state: sent-to-root; needs correction/explicit disposition and recapture

findings.problem: Seeded queue name1 vs1ranked displays with first numeral displaced to the right, visually vs1ranked1; analogous2vs2 fixture does the same. The label is authored data, not a missing translation.
findings.proposal: Isolate whole queue data labels with bdi/dir=auto so their own first strong Latin character controls internal direction while Urdu surrounding layout staysRTL.
findings.state: sent-to-root; source correction/explicit disposition and fresh evidence required

interaction_followup.observation: Leftward rating data is clipped inside the narrow table while Player/Outcome remain visible. TableWrap suggests intentional horizontal scrolling, so screenshot alone cannot classify usability failure.
interaction_followup.required_evidence: Pan the table in the phone viewport and confirm complete before/after values can be read; if no scroll affordance, consider a responsive stacked rating presentation.

positive_observations: Connected Arabic-script glyph shaping and Urdu punctuation readable across all20images; no tofu observed.
Urdu headings, body text, account deletion warnings, controls and card titles generally wrap without overlap or viewport-edge clipping.
Invite joincode and footerURL remain readable; whole longURL behavior not shown.
Seeded English player/map/room names and technical identifiers distinguished from catalog prose.
limits: Independent agent visual review, not human native-speaker approval.
Actual local app in desktop Chromium at1200/390 CSS pixel widths;390 is a browser phone viewport, not nativeAndroid/iOS/device verification.
Images were actually read; automation overflow0/axe reports are recorded provenance only, not substitutes for visual judgment.
All twenty route screenshots are whole-page static images; no claim that every interactive flow, screenreader, formoperation or apppage was exercised by reviewer.
Sharedsourcefixes require new exactbuild screenshots before visual gate can pass.
